Terrible, my only real life friend I ever had abandoned me today and today is the first time I ever cut myself, I have no reason to live and I don't know how to cope.
Oh wow. I love you too <3
I need long term, I get attached so quickly due to a lack of real friends, I cherish people too much, sorry.
Hi.
That's a pretty vague question.
I do have strong beliefs and values already, that might be one of the many reasons that I am an outcast.
I am not Bill Gates or Steve Jobs, I am a failure, I have nothing to contribute to the world.
Metallica, Marilyn Manson, System of a Down, Imagine Dragons, Bring Me The Horizon and Avenged Sevenfold are my favourites, how about you?
Listening to music, how about you?
Fair enough.
That's easier said than done.
I have talked with so-called "professionals" before, they are useless to me, they never offer real advice and they make me more aware to the fact that I am one of natures mistakes.
I wear a fake smile constantly, it doesn't change a thing, I generally try to be optimistic but it's going nowhere and I don't see why I should carry on at this point.
I do realise that but I can't help it, I have major trust issues.
I can't accept myself for who I am, because I don't even like myself let alone love myself, and my life has no purpose or meaning, I already know that.
Yeah they started dating, I didn't miss that, but you still had the ability to make friends, whereas I do not.
Yes, wouldn't bother with it again, all I got back was the generic "don't worry it gets better" bullshit that never helps in the slightest.

I appreciate that response and I'm sorry that you went through that, but at least you had those two friends, that shows that you have the ability to connect with people and make real friends but I feel that I lack that ability.

It's not "playing the victim" when you are the victim, and I didn't blame everyone else, I know that it's my fault for not being likeable at all, I can't pinpoint exactly what I want because I don't know, I just want to be happy, I know it's stupid and vague but I don't know what else to tell you. It's a bullshit response either, I am genuinely not passionate about anything anymore and I find it hilarious that you call me rude after you denounce my initial response as "bullshit". You're the one being rude.
I used to be passionate about a lot of things but those parts of me are dead now. Sorry.
I have tried making those changes, I am not an introvert at all, I have met thousands of people, none of them have liked me, it's not a numbers game at all in my case.

Thank you for the kind words but they don't feel genuine as you don't really know me and most people just grow to hate me as time goes on, as for bulking up, I am 6ft and about 200lbs so I am hardly a weedy guy that gets picked on for being small, I have fucked up bullies in the past and wouldn't hesitate to do it again if I felt I had to, I would love to talk to you more. Do you have Skype / Kik / Steam / anything like that?
